name: Rocket Fuel - (5g) Baller Bucket - Gary Payton
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Rocket Fuel Gary Payton Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Gary Payton is a potent, balanced hybrid from the Cookies family, crossing The Y with Snowman. Expect a loud, complex profile: sharp gas and pepper up front, layered with earthy, herbal notes and a subtly sweet, creamy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a strong, clear-headed lift paired with easy body relaxation.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Gary Payton flavor — sharp gas and pepper with earthy, herbal, creamy notes
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Gary Payton is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
